name: followup-voice-agent
description: Always-on audio bridge between Twilio Media Streams and OpenAI's Realtime API. Deployed as its own Vercel project, separate from the main followup Next.js app, because a live phone call needs a persistent bidirectional connection that a normal request/response Next.js route can't hold open. See followup/src/lib/twilio.ts (voiceAgentStreamUrl, validateVoiceAgentCallbackAuth) for the other side of this integration, and followup/research/integrations/2026-09-06-voice-ai-and-multilingual-scoping.md for why this architecture was chosen over a third-party voice-AI platform.
